items.title: Pay invoice for December 2026 flex desk membership and meeting room
items.quote: Please settle this invoice within 14 days of the invoice date.
items.computation: This is a private contractual payment period, not a statutory notice from an authority, so the general rule of §187(1) BGB (period triggered by an event) applies: the invoice date itself (21 Nov 2026, a Saturday) is not counted; counting starts the next day, 22 Nov 2026 = day 1. Day 14 is therefore 5 Dec 2026. Under §193 BGB, if the last day of a period for performing an obligation falls on a Sunday, Saturday or a public holiday, it is postponed to the next business day. 5 Dec 2026 is a Saturday (14 days after Saturday 21 Nov, i.e. same weekday), and 6 Dec (Sunday) is also non-business; 6 Dec is not a public holiday in NW. The next business day is Monday, 7 Dec 2026.
